name: 47-google-no-prefill-and-content-coercion
description:
Two things at once. (1) 'gemini-3.7-flash' matches /gemini-3\.[67]-flash/ (:457), so the LAST turn is a prefill and its assistant role becomes 'user' (:466) -- which then merges it into the preceding user turn with '

' -- while the earlier assistant turn (index 1, not last) keeps role 'model'. (2) The text of a non-array content goes through `String(message.content ?? '')` (:483): the integer 42 becomes '42' and the JSON float 5.0 becomes '5' (JavaScript numbers have no integral form), not '5.0'. Expected contents: [user[text 'A'], model[text '42'], user[text '5

C

D']].
